summary: Defined staging, activation, active artifact set, deactivation and rollback report contracts that separate inert staging from active runtime behavior.
acceptance_evidence: ActivationReportV1 binds activated artifacts to AgentCore plan id, SecurityExecution run id, audit range, approval id, approval token hash, policy version, rollback handle and active set hashes.
ActiveArtifactSetV1 can reconstruct active artifact state with coordinate, manifest digest, activation report id, rollback handle and policy version.
Unsupported artifact kinds cannot activate in the alpha activation contract.
blocked_shortcuts: Staged state cannot prepare activation side effects.
Activation reports cannot omit audit range, policy version or rollback handle.
Active and staged state are represented by separate contracts.
optional_dependencies: No external service is required to reconstruct active artifact state.
promotion_impact: Provides the durable active-state contract needed before aom activation can be mediated by Agent Runtime.
